en: Making you feel relaxed and not in pain; or feeling relaxed and at ease.
ex: This sofa is very comfortable.
這張沙發非常舒服。

en: Found in many places or happening often; or shared by two or more people.
ex: Smith is a very common surname in English.
史密斯是英語中很常見的姓氏。

en: An electronic machine that can store and work with information.
ex: I use a computer to do my homework.
我用電腦做功課。

en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs; or near and easy to reach.
ex: The hotel is in a convenient location near the station.
這家旅館位置方便，靠近車站。

en: To prepare food by heating it; or a person whose job is to prepare food.
ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
我媽媽每天晚上做晚餐。

en: A small, flat, sweet cake, usually baked; or a small file saved by a website on your computer.
ex: We baked cookies for the school party.
我們為學校派對烤了餅乾。

en: Slightly cold, in a pleasant way; or calm and not excited; or fashionable and good (informal).
ex: It is cool in the shade of the tree.
在樹蔭下很涼爽。

en: To make something that is exactly like another thing; or one of many examples of the same book or document.
ex: Please make a copy of this document for me.
請幫我影印這份文件。

en: The place where two walls or roads meet and form an angle; or to force someone into a position with no escape.
ex: The shop is on the corner of the street.
那家店在街角。

en: Having no mistakes; or the right way; or to make something right.
ex: Your answer to the question is correct.
你的答案是正確的。

en: The amount of money you need to pay for something; or to have a certain price.
ex: The cost of the trip is about two hundred dollars.
這趟旅行的費用大約是兩百美元。

en: A long, soft seat for two or more people; or to express something in a particular way.
ex: He fell asleep on the couch watching TV.
他看電視時在沙發上睡著了。

en: To say numbers in order; or to find the total; or to be important.
ex: The little girl can count from one to twenty.
那個小女孩可以從一數到二十。

en: An area of land with its own government, such as Taiwan or Japan; or land outside cities.
ex: Taiwan is a small country with beautiful mountains.
台灣是個有著美麗山脈的小國。

en: A series of lessons on a subject; or a direction that something takes; or a part of a meal.
ex: She is taking a French course at night.
她晚上在上法語課程。

en: A child of your uncle or aunt.
ex: My cousin lives in Canada.
我的表哥住在加拿大。

en: To put something over something else to protect or hide it; or the outer part of a book.
ex: Cover the pot with a lid and let it boil.
把鍋子蓋上蓋子煮滾。

en: A large farm animal that is kept for its milk and meat.
ex: The farmer milks his cows every morning.
農夫每天早上擠牛奶。

en: Very strange or silly; or very enthusiastic about something.
ex: It would be crazy to go out in this storm.
在這場暴風雨中出門太瘋狂了。

en: To go from one side of something to the other; or an X-shaped mark; or annoyed.
ex: Look both ways before you cross the street.
過馬路前要看兩邊。

en: To produce tears because you are sad or hurt; or to shout loudly.
ex: The baby began to cry when she woke up.
寶寶醒來時開始哭了。

en: A small round container with a handle for drinking hot drinks; or a prize in sports.
ex: She poured a cup of tea for her guest.
她為客人倒了一杯茶。

en: To use a knife or scissors to divide something; or to make something smaller or shorter.
ex: Please cut the cake into eight pieces.
請把蛋糕切成八塊。

en: Attractive in a charming way, especially young animals or children.
ex: The puppy is so cute that everyone wants to hold it.
那隻小狗太可愛了，每個人都想抱牠。

en: To move your body to music; or a party where people do this; or a set of steps done to music.
ex: They danced all night at the party.
他們在派對上跳了一整夜的舞。

en: Likely to cause harm or injury.
ex: It is dangerous to swim in this river.
在這條河裡游泳很危險。

en: With little or no light; or a deep color that is close to black; or the absence of light.
ex: It gets dark early in winter.
冬天天黑得早。

en: A particular day of the month or year; or a planned meeting, especially a romantic one.
ex: What is today's date?
今天幾號？

en: Your female child.
ex: Their daughter is studying at a university in London.
他們的女兒在倫敦的一所大學讀書。

en: A period of twenty-four hours; or the time when it is light outside.
ex: There are seven days in a week.
一週有七天。

en: No longer alive; or not working; or completely.
ex: The flowers are dead because no one watered them.
花都死了，因為沒有人澆水。

en: An agreement, especially in business; or to take action to solve a problem; or to give out cards in a game.
ex: We made a deal to share the cost of the trip.
我們談好要分攤這趟旅行的費用。

en: Loved and valued; or used to start a letter; or costing a lot of money.
ex: Dear Mary, thank you for your letter.
親愛的瑪麗，謝謝你的來信。

en: The end of life; the fact of a person or animal dying.
ph: a matter of life and death
ex: The news of his death shocked everyone.
他的死訊震驚了每個人。

en: To choose after thinking about different possibilities; or to make a judgment.
ex: I decided to study abroad next year.
我決定明年出國讀書。

en: Going far down from the top or surface; or very strong, as in feelings or sleep.
ex: The lake is very deep in the middle.
湖的中間非常深。

en: To say exactly what a word means; or to state clearly what something is.
ex: Can you define the word "freedom"?
你能說明「自由」這個詞的定義嗎？

en: A table, often with drawers, where you write, read or work.
ex: He sat at his desk and began to write.
他坐在書桌前開始寫字。

en: A book that gives the meanings of words in alphabetical order.
ex: If you don't know the word, look it up in a dictionary.
如果你不認識這個字，就去查字典。

en: To stop living; or to become weaker and disappear gradually.
ex: The old tree died last winter.
那棵老樹去年冬天枯死了。
